diagnostic_representations.target_support_auc: threshold-free held-out AUC of the frozen target-support score within each exact Pi coordinate
diagnostic_representations.full_signature_lda_auc: held-out AUC of a fixed ridge-LDA projection fitted only on the 12-dimensional dimensionless signature
diagnostic_representations.nuisance_support_auc: threshold-free held-out AUC of frozen nuisance support for nuisance-only vs target-only
diagnostic_representations.nuisance_threshold_recall: held-out recall at the already-frozen nuisance_high=0.55 threshold

interpretation_rules_prefrozen.representation_defect_candidate: median full-signature held-out AUC >= 0.80 in a T+N comparison while the locked V14a2 plateau remains highly ambiguous
interpretation_rules_prefrozen.essential_ambiguity_candidate: median full-signature held-out AUC <= 0.60 in a T+N comparison
interpretation_rules_prefrozen.nuisance_scale_mismatch: median nuisance-support AUC >= 0.90 while recall at frozen 0.55 threshold < 0.20
interpretation_rules_prefrozen.no_retuning: diagnostic AUCs classify the failure source; they do not authorize changing V14a2 thresholds or rerunning its locked sweep

claim_boundary: post-result failure-source diagnosis only; cannot alter V14a2 Q1/Q3 results or establish field performance
